title: CSM ddd suite config namespace
description: Bounded, non-authority analysis caps for the csm-ddd namespace of csm-skills-config/1. Only read-scan file and byte ceilings are configurable and may only narrow within these hard bounds; report/graph artifact ownership, path containment, publication pointer/lock semantics, lifecycle, credentials, and write scope are never granted here. Unknown keys are rejected.

maxFiles.description: Maximum number of files the read-only repository scan may consider (1-5000).

maxBytes.description: Maximum total bytes the read-only repository scan may read (1-10000000).
